morbi.headline: Morbi faces severe export contraction alongside recurring domestic trade credit defaults and fraud.
what_changed: India's ceramic tile export volumes plunged 46% during April-July 2026, leading to a weak full-year FY27 export outlook.
Multiple buyer fraud incidents emerged, exposing manufacturers to unsecured trade credit defaults in the domestic market.
stress_signals: Export volumes dropped 46% year-on-year in Apr-Jul 2026, severely dampening the FY27 demand outlook for ceramic tile makers [434975bd08e0].
A Mumbai-based buyer allegedly defrauded a Morbi ceramic unit of Rs 44 lakh after procuring tiles on credit [e694c857f915].
A buyer absconded after securing 7,865 ceramic tile boxes on credit, reflecting recurring unsecured payment defaults in the cluster [76fdd3301f32].
what_to_watch: Full-year FY27 export trajectory and subsequent export volume prints following the 46% drop in Apr-Jul 2026.
Elongation of debtor collection cycles and rising non-payment/fraud risks on unsecured domestic credit sales.
Working capital utilization and cash flow stress in export-focused tile manufacturing units facing volume drops.

surat.headline: Surat faces loom shutdowns, labour unrest, and diamond export drops despite GST relief.
what_changed: Textile weaving units face pre-Diwali closures and month-long shutdowns due to a 50% raw material surge and yarn price hike of ₹50/kg.
Embroidery sector turmoil escalated into strikes, detention of over 80 workers, union disputes, and worker departures.
A broader textile labor strike and protest over working conditions has triggered reverse migration of workers to UP and Bihar.
Diamond sector activity softened with polished exports dropping 7% alongside UK scrutiny on lab-grown diamond marketing.
stress_signals: A 50% jump in raw material costs and ₹50/kg yarn hike threaten pre-Diwali closures, including a planned month-long loom shutdown affecting 75,000 workers [48c63a4e50b6, b567711c9ed4].
Persistent 3-month embroidery sector impasse, worker unrest, detention of 80+ workers, and union extortion charges disrupt job-work capacity [7697e96a190e, e7921383cbb7, 9d4f02830710, af8a29b318b7].
Eight-hour power outages, textile market fires, and a boiler blast in Udhna disrupt continuous manufacturing operations [167f80ff6cdc, f36719f0f644, 691b478fe424].
Payment defaults and trade fraud surfaced, including a ₹10.14 crore Mumbai fraud case, a ₹29.57 lakh grey fabric default, and unpaid polishing charges [2514ad7d6e20, c4997bb35d98, 698c779932f2].
improvement_signals: GST Council eased liquidity by granting ITC refunds and reducing highway transport inspections [17f0a015a73c].
ICA-GemLab announced plans to open its first Indian testing laboratory for gems and jewellery in Surat [26bd1ecd549c].
Bridal demand for lab-grown diamonds is shifting toward larger stone sizes, and the cluster is diversifying into defence technical textiles [694aea903d0a, 0f163b499572].
what_to_watch: Monitoring working capital utilisation and cash velocity in embroidery units amid prolonged disputes and machine-loan servicing pressures.
Details and rollout of the new textile policy expected within three months, alongside outcomes of central government hub studies.
Resolution of migrant labor shortages and rail transport negotiations via FOSTA before the post-Diwali operational cycle resumes.
Export realization trends for polished and lab-grown diamonds following the 7% shipment dip and UK regulatory crackdowns.
